title: Language settings file
description: Per language: which engine makes its audio, and the settings that engine needs.

languages.description: Settings per language code, for example fr.

name.description: English name of the language, used in the AI prompt.

engine.description: kokoro makes the audio with the Kokoro model; recording uses the user's own recordings.

voice.description: Kokoro voice name. Only for the kokoro engine.

kokoro_lang_code.description: Kokoro language code, a single letter. Only for the kokoro engine.

default_speed.description: Speed used when a lesson's tuning file does not set one. Only for engines that have a speed.

end_cue.description: Text of the sentence that says a lesson is finished, in this language. Required for a language used as a meaning language.
